bitget.disclosure: The Bitget official MCP server and the Bitget web/API hosts are unreachable from the network this build ran on (every attempt fails at the TCP layer, not the application layer). AnalogDesk therefore ships no Bitget-sourced figure. All data comes from the keyless sources in research/DATA-PROVENANCE.md, and this disclosure is rendered in the provenance panel rather than hidden.
